title: Operational Amplifier
text: Model operational amplifier with two or more poles, 2 inputs, 2 outputs; {Operational Amplifier Circuit} sets the type of operational amplifier circuit Double-pole, {Inherit sample interval from input}, {Sample interval (s)} sets the sample interval value used in MATLAB analyses, {Simulate using} selects simulation mode, {Supply rail high (V)} sets the maximum supply voltage, {Supply rail low (V)} sets the minimum supply voltage, {Input offset voltage (V)} sets the offset voltage at input terminals, {Open loop gain (V/V)} sets the operational amplifier gain without feedback, {Unity gain bandwidth (Hz)} sets the frequency at which operational amplifier gain equals unity, {Maximum tail current (A)} sets the maximum current passing through tail MOSFET in operational amplifier circuit, {Slew rate (V/s)} sets the rate of change of operational amplifier output voltage, {Output resistance (Ohms)} sets the resistance at output, {Output Capacitance (F)} sets the capacitance at output, {Transfer function poles} sets the poles in transfer function in Laplace domain, {Transfer function zeroes} sets the zeros in transfer function in Laplace domain, {Include Z-domain approximation} sets the include z -domain approximation while plotting open loop and {Plot open loop response}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Operational Amplifier Circuit
params.values: Type of operational amplifier circuit Double-pole Circuit (default) | Multipole Circuit

params.values: Inherit sample interval from input off (default) | on
